$comment: The platform master's starter content (GLOBAL_MASTER.md, AMD-0025, DEC-016): kinds, hierarchies, identifier schemes, units, the trade taxonomy with each industry's required and recommended capabilities, the tariff chapters, attribute definitions bound to the taxonomy, item kinds with their fulfilment modes, relationship types and vocabularies. Data, not code: lib/master.js writes what is missing into the kernel and never overwrites an edit. Capability keys an industry or kind names that no atom yet provides are what discovery reports as requested.
